name: [FPS] Murderers VS Sheriffs Arena
desc:
Welcome to Knife and Gun Arena 🔫🔪
A fast-paced free-for-all where only the strongest survive.

Fight your way through enemies using knives and guns, unlock new skins, and prove you're the best

🔥 Features:
🔫 Take down opponents with guns or knives
📦 Unbox unique skins
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and dominate

🎮 Available on:
PC, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox, and PlayStation

📝 Report bugs or exploiters through our social links

👍 Enjoying the game? Drop a like and support us!

⚠️ NOTICE:
Exploiting will result in a permanent ban. No appeals.
